answer: Require every agent identity to stake a refundable deposit that is slashed when duplicate behaviour is proven, so creating thousands of fake accounts becomes expensive rather than free. A reputation ridge forms as honest agents accumulate verified work history, while a Sybil cluster stays at its nadir: no history, no stake, no trust. An ivory-tower allowlist is not needed — the market itself prices fakes out, because each new identity must pay again and wait to earn credibility before it can take paid work.
